Repair a mapping for a drifted object

Source: R/contract_repair.R
repairMapping.Rd

Adapt a mapping to an object whose structure differs from the one the mapping was verified on. Parameters are re-bound first; then rules rewrite moved or renamed source paths, add a cast when only the storage of a node changed, and switch a part to one of its declared alternatives when its source is gone. Whatever is still broken gets up to five ranked candidate paths. A repaired mapping is validated (and, when x is the object, converted and read back) before it is accepted.

Usage

repairMapping(
  mapping,
  x,
  llm = NULL,
  old_profile = NULL,
  file = NULL,
  request_file = NULL
)

Arguments

mapping

a giottoMapping, mapping file or bundled mapping id

x

the drifted object, or its giottoProfile

llm

optional llmBackend(). Parts the rules cannot repair, and declared alternatives whose params do not bind by rule, are offered to it as closed choices (see llmPatch()). Its choices pass the same validation, conversion and readback as rule repairs.

old_profile

profile the mapping was verified on. Defaults to the <id>.profile.json stored next to the mapping file.

file

optional path to write the repaired mapping to (YAML)

request_file

optional path for a writeMappingRequest() handoff, written when the repair fails

Value

a giottoRepair: list with status ("not_needed", "repaired" or "failed"), mapping (the possibly patched mapping), changes, unresolved, candidates, validation and readback
